ev.q: In 2021, the U.S. birth rate for females aged 15–19 years was 13.9 births per 1,000 persons
In 2021, the U.S. birth rate for females aged 15–19 years was 13.9 births per 1,000 persons
with rates generally lower in the Northeast and higher across the southern states
Birth rates among females aged 15–19 years ranged from 5.4 in New Hampshire, 5.7 in Massachusetts, and 6.4 in Vermont to 26.5 in Arkansas
